question: Can you provide the number of distinct active and closed bike share stations for each year 2013 and 2014?
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) as year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN t.start_station_id END) as active_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN t.start_station_id END) as closed_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
